rationale: User asked for workspaces. Mux owns the session tree and workspace tags; HWND is a view of one MuxWindow. New tabs use Domain::spawn so they sit on a mux Tab. Extra split leaves stay GPUI SplitLayout (040). Switch hides/shows HWNDs (Win32 ShowWindow) instead of destroying AppShell. Create uses generate_workspace_name with no prompt. Last HWND of a workspace falls back to another workspace if any remain. Do not start unix Attach, Mux::split_pane rewrite, 026/031, or window/ cutover.
